m15.text: Jalira and Yisan compete to rob the same rambling Thunian man in the market of Lesh, and when guard commander Dexros tries to arrest them, Yisan spooks the horses with a hummed tune and Jalira turns the thrown guards into frogs, so they flee.
Outside the city, Yisan reads the stolen journal of the Thunian scout Hastric, which reveals a sliver hive with abandoned treasure, and Jalira decides to go.

They journey through the Kalonian Forest and find the sliver cave, where Jalira, over Yisan's objections, uses blue smoke on them, and as slivers they fight to keep their minds against the hive's hum.
Yisan decides to stay to study the slivers' music, while Jalira takes the treasure to Martyne.
